text:
ana: Quick prelaunch sync — need to lock SI onboarding, press embargo, and localized landing handoff. Pinged owners below. tl;dr: blocking items are legal quote clearance, final marketplace metadata, and SI test harness. @liam @sophie @deepak @marco :eyes:

liam: I can take marketplace metadata. Do we have final SKU names and pricing tiers? Also need the short product blurb for the catalog tile.

sophie: For press embargo I propose 2026-04-02 17:00 UTC (10:00am PT) — aligns with partner windows. We should also prepare a 1-paragraph blog + 3 pull quotes. I'll coordinate localization once content is final. @ana will you confirm the embargo? :calendar:

deepak: SI onboarding status: integration guide is at ~80%. Dev sandbox and terraform examples are ready for partner testing tomorrow. We still need a sample workload/benchmark from the partner to validate autoscale settings. Also want to confirm we can expose the test endpoint in staging (team ok?).

marco: Legal: need confirmation on any customer names/quotes used in press. If there are third-party logos on the landing, get logo use approval. Please drop approvals here or send to legal@redwood.com. Without that we can't clear the embargo assets.

ana: (typo) — ana: @marco noted. We'll collect approvals today.

deploy-bot: build-ci #marketplace-staging succeeded (artifact: s3://redwood-artifacts/marketplace/2958-build.tar.gz) :white_check_mark:

ana: putting a short checklist here — owners in parens:
```
- Marketplace listing: final metadata & SKU (liam)
- Catalog tile copy + 1-paragraph blog (sophie)
- Landing pages: EN + 6 locales, QA + tracking (sophie)
- SI docs: integration guide + terraform examples (deepak)
- SI partner test window: tomorrow 0900-1500 PT (deepak + partners)
- Press embargo: 2026-04-02 17:00 UTC (sophie)
- Legal signoff for quotes/logos (marco)
- Staging deploy verification (eng-oncall)
```

liam: I uploaded draft SKU JSON to the drive: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/marketplace/sku-drafts. Will update by EOD. For pricing tiers, we recommend keeping initial commit conservative — tier 1 + burst only, no reserved commit yet.

sophie: I'll draft the blog and 3 pull quotes and share for review by 17:00 PT. Localization owners: ping @amanda_apac and @jaime_eu to prep translations once copy is frozen.

deepak: Can someone from partner side drop the performance sample? We need to run the autoscale stress test. If not today, push to tomorrow morning and we'll run in the 0900 slot.

marco: Once copy is up, legal will do a same-day review if the quotes are internal. External customer quotes need the customer's email approval attached.

ana: action items summary: liam update SKU, sophie blog + localization handoff, deepak run SI tests tomorrow, marco legal signoff by EOD. If anyone hits a blocker post here.

liam: ack.

sophie: ack, prepping PR to share in this thread when ready :rocket: 

deepak: ack, will post test results in channel and include simple command to run the harness.

marco: ack — pinged legal ops for expedited review.

ana: thanks all — next quick checkin at 15:30 PT in #partnerships. If everything is green we'll proceed with embargo timeline and staging cutover. :thumbsup:

sophie: small note — please save the final hero image to the shared assets folder with filenames like hero-en.jpg, hero-es.jpg, etc. I'll validate sizing.

liam: adding a tiny note on monitoring: route analytics event 'marketplace_view' on landing and 'install_started' on marketplace click to help product ops.

deepak: will add backend tracing hooks and token/latency metrics to the staging deploy.

ana: perfect. closing thread for now, will reopen if blockers appear.
